C.title: A new ball
lines: In her starry bedroom, Gail notices a soft blue ball rolling toward the broom charm Mira once gave her.
The ball and charm come to rest side by side.

C.title: Back to the roof
lines: Once both objects have stopped, their lights join in one circle.
The doorway opens onto the familiar rooftop school where Mira learned her first low flight.
C.translation: 兩件物品都停穩後，光合成一圈。|門外是熟悉的屋頂學校，Mira 曾在那裡學會第一次低飛。

C.title: Hello again, Mira
lines: Mira finishes a careful low circle and lands safely on the thick cushion.
She still practices small steps, and she is delighted to see Gail again.
C.translation: Mira 小心繞完一個低圈，安全落在厚墊上。|她仍在一步步練習，很高興再次見到瑜瑜。

C.title: A new game
lines: The teacher brings out a magic ball for a game on the marked rooftop field.
It gives a gentle bounce and waits for the children to begin.
C.translation: 老師把魔法球帶到標好的安全練習區。|球輕輕彈一下，等孩子們開始。

C.title: Many ideas
lines: Mira suggests passing the ball, while another player wants to kick it toward the low hoop.
A third child wants everyone to throw first; the ball remains still.
C.translation: Mira 建議傳球，另一位玩家想把球踢向低光圈。|第三個孩子想先用丟的，球仍待在原地。

C.title: Too many calls
lines: The players call out different instructions at the same time, but the ball does not hit anyone.
The ball darts left and right, unable to follow two rules at once, so the teacher keeps everyone back.
C.translation: 玩家們同時喊出不同指令。|球忽左忽右，無法同時遵守兩套規則，老師讓大家先退開。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: No shared goal
lines: The ball circles the low goal without going through it and rolls back to the starting point. No one can score a point.
The children look at one another; no one knows what counts.
C.translation: 球繞過低矮的目標圈，沒有穿過去，又滾回起點。|孩子們面面相覷，沒有人知道什麼才算完成。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Pause the game
lines: Gail asks the players to pause before anyone runs after the ball.
It slows beside the cushion, and the teacher checks that the play area is safe.
C.translation: 瑜瑜請玩家們先暫停，不要追著球跑。|球在厚墊旁慢下來，老師確認場地安全。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Listen to each player
lines: Instead of calling over one another, each player in the small crowd describes the game they hoped to play.
Gail and Mira listen until everyone has had a turn.
C.translation: 玩家們不再互相蓋過聲音，而是輪流說出自己希望怎麼玩。|瑜瑜和 Mira 聽到每個人都說完。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Mira remembers
lines: Mira recalls how one small practice step helped her learn a safe low flight.
She suggests agreeing on just one rule before adding anything else.
C.translation: Mira 想起當初一個小步驟幫她學會安全低飛。|她建議先同意一條規則，之後再加其他內容。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Draw the first rule
lines: On a card without words, the teacher draws a ball traveling from one child to the next.
Nobody grabs it from another player’s hands.
C.translation: 老師在無字圖卡上畫出球從一個孩子傳給下一個孩子。|沒有人從別人手中搶球。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Agree to try
lines: After each player has seen the picture card, everyone agrees to try the pass-first rule.
The ball shines softly, yet it stays still until they are ready.
C.translation: 每位玩家都看過圖卡後，一起同意先傳球。|球柔柔發光，但仍等大家準備好才動。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: One careful pass
lines: Mira looks toward Gail, then sends the ball along a short arc for her to catch.
For the first time, the magic ball has one clear instruction to follow.
C.translation: Mira 望向瑜瑜，再讓球沿短弧傳過去。|魔法球第一次有了單一明確的指令。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Wait for a turn
lines: Gail catches the ball and holds it steady before making the next pass.
Her friend waits instead of reaching in, so everyone can follow the game.
C.translation: 瑜瑜先接穩球，再傳下一棒。|朋友沒有伸手搶，大家都能跟上遊戲。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Add a goal
lines: Once the passing rule works, everyone agrees to send the ball through the low hoop at the end.
The teacher keeps the thick cushion in place beneath it.
C.translation: 傳球規則順利後，大家同意最後讓球穿過低光圈。|老師把厚墊留在圈下。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Try the whole game
lines: In their friendly match, the ball travels from player to player in order.
After the last careful pass, it glides through the low hoop and returns to the starting area.
C.translation: 這次球依順序在玩家之間傳遞。|最後一次穩穩的傳球後，它滑過低光圈，回到起點。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Change one rule
lines: When one pass comes too quickly, the children pause again instead of blaming anyone; they want a fair game.
They add a simple picture of eyes: look at your partner before sending the ball.
C.translation: 一次傳球太快，孩子們再次暫停，沒有責怪誰。|他們在圖卡加上眼睛：傳球前先看同伴。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: Play together
lines: Mira, Gail, and their friends follow the rule they all helped make.
The ball moves smoothly through the low hoop, and every player gets a turn.
C.translation: Mira、瑜瑜與朋友遵守大家一起訂出的規則。|球平穩穿過低光圈，每位玩家都有回合。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: A rule everyone knows
lines: The teacher asks each child to demonstrate the agreed steps.
Mira can explain them clearly, and the quiet ball returns to Gail’s hands.
C.translation: 老師請每個孩子示範共同約定的步驟。|Mira 能清楚說明，安靜的球回到瑜瑜手上。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。

C.title: A shared memory
lines: Back in her familiar bedroom, Gail places the magic ball beside Mira’s old broom charm.
She remembers that a good game begins when everyone can help decide how to play.
C.translation: 回到熟悉的臥室，瑜瑜把魔法球放在 Mira 的舊掃帚吊飾旁。|她記得，好玩的遊戲從大家一起決定玩法開始。

mission.hint: 點一點畫面中的獨立道具或角色，聽聽它的名字。
